positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed Level 2 EVSE controller with OCPP1.6 (Python, C)
• Analyzed Home Charger requirements including mobile app and cloud interactions
• Led network validation tests & commissioning processes with multiple networks (EVSP)
• Troubleshoot field issues including RFID authentication, Meter Value reporting, network
connectivity, etc.
• Worked with Sierra LX60 modem for cellular connectivity
• Led system stability project to meet over 95% of the system uptime

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led Voice Calling application team as a Technical leader and re-designed voice calling applications from C code to C++ via Object Oriented Design.
•	Developed Direct Connect Call (Push to Talk), Telephony services (such as multi-way calls, call waiting, call forwarding, emergency calls) using C/C++ languages.
•	Analyzed and implemented the Telephony middleware APIs and interfaces to integrate Google Android Telephony features to Qualcomm MSM chipset.
•	Designed and performed automated unit tests, user requirement tests, integration tests and system tests for all calling features with extensive testing based on Agile methods. 
•	Worked with various network signaling protocols such as CDMA, GSM and UMTS
•	Led GSM/UMTS GCF certification testing and CDMA IOT testing with multiple teams and successfully received certifications in time to ship Motorola’s first Android phones to multiple carriers.  
•	Worked with device driver, bootloader, kernel development when bring up the mobile
•	Worked with Git on Linux, Unix, real-time operating systems, serial communications, IP networking.
